critical.issue: UnboundLocalError: `casillas` referenced at line 1637 before assignment (introduced during iteration 55 refactor of PX section). Fixed by T1: extract `casillas` from `route_data.get('casillas', ...)` before its first use. All calculate-journey requests returned 500 prior to the fix — this broke the main travel calculator and the partial-fast-pace feature end-to-end.

rca of the issue: Root cause: iteration 55's refactor of PX calculation (segmented vs fallback) renamed `casillas` → `num_casillas` inside the else branch, but left the post-PX block using the old `casillas` identifier. Since `casillas` was only set inside inner route_builder helpers (different scope), Python raised UnboundLocalError at line 1637. Mitigation: read casillas from `route_data['casillas']` (every route builder populates it) before first use, with a fallback distance/16. Reproduction: POST /api/travel/calculate-journey with any origen_id/destino_id → 500. Post-fix: 200 with correct dias_estimados and PX.
